author: John Hammond
description:
We're messing around with a Minecraft mod for a malware analysis environment.

Right now, we have virtual machine management inside Minecraft. The goal is to eventually use the mod to explore the open internet and download files, payloads, and configurations into a sandboxed analysis environment, with an implant or beacon driving the VM. 

Watch the full video here: https://www.youtube.com/live/4SoKErPUy9Y?si=nWmO9ocPy22XlMhf
title: Minecraft Malware Lab
